first_meeting.line: That bike yours? Keep it off the shoulder past the old line yard. Ground's full of things that'll open a tire.

line.line: Went dark in sections, then all at once. Substation east of here is the closest place worth checking. Don't assume dead means safe.

charge.line: Substation east of here used to feed half the valley. Dead last I checked. Dry Creek's safer if you've got a turbine. Slower, though.

salvage.line: Redline yard. Everybody picks the easy piles. Nobody wants to crawl under anything. That's why there's still good copper there.

after_signal.line: You hear that carrier last night? Don't tell me that was weather. Weather doesn't repeat itself.
